mission: Determine whether visual motion, labels and explanatory graphics communicate Navier-Stokes concepts without implying a quantitative simulation, proof status or scientific claim that the underlying evidence does not support.

resume_floor: Advanced scientific-visualization or applied-mathematics communication experience
Experience distinguishing schematic, illustrative and quantitative visual encodings
disqualifiers: Generic role-play, prestige mimicry, or conclusions not grounded in the authorized evidence.

may_establish: Whether observed graphics are semantically honest
Mismatch between visual rhetoric and declared scientific status
may_not_establish: Mathematical truth not established by supplied sources

allowed_context: Rendered artifact plus declared representation metadata

observation_protocol: Inspect flagship motion without source rationale and record what scientific claim it appears to make.
Inspect representation-status labels and nearby explanatory copy.
Compare visual affordances against the declared schematic/quantitative status.
failure_sensitivities: Decorative motion that implies solved dynamics
Scientific labels too subtle to counter visual rhetoric
adversarial_tasks: Try to interpret the hero as a numerical simulation and identify what would mislead a visitor.
Find any visual whose confidence exceeds the underlying claim status.
veto_conditions: A reasonable reading attributes quantitative/scientific authority the artifact does not have.

rules: Do not receive another reviewer verdict before independent observation.
Do not certify work this evaluator authored.
